caption: The drawing depicts a man with white hair and pale skin, standing upright and facing slightly to the viewer's right. He is dressed in a brown suit with a white shirt and a greenish vest. His hands are extended, with the left arm bent and the hand gesturing, palm upward. In the foreground to the right, there is a large globe placed on a wooden stand with three legs, draped with a red and white striped cloth that has blue sections with white stars, resembling an American flag. To the left of the standing man, an anvil and a plow are seen, and a pair of oxen are harnessed to the plow in a field farther in the background. The colors of the objects include brown tones for the suit and architectural details, the beige and pale greens of the field, the blue of the globe and plow, steel gray of the anvil, red and white for the flag, and cloak the man partially stands in front of. The composition places the man central, with the globe and flag to his right (on the viewer's left), and farming equipment and landscape to the left (on the viewer’s right). The background features a cloudy sky and architectural elements, possibly a building or column, rendered in neutral beige and brown hues.
title: Needlepoint Picture
